name: Hellshard
desc: A pixel-perfect dark-fantasy action roguelite: descend through the Cinder Cemetery and the Ashen Cathedral as one of four vessels, claim two Hellshards, and silence both wardens. Three.js-rendered with vanilla ES modules; original code, UI and generated sprites, with CC0 and freely-licensed tilesets credited in CREDITS.md.
controls: A/D or arrows move, Space/W/Up jump, Shift dash (i-frames), J basic attack, K heavy attack, L character ability, E interact, Esc pause, 1-3 choose level-up cards
creator: JaynusHUB
